serviceBlock.h2: Our Moving and Storage Services in Boston
serviceBlock.intro: When people need storage with their move, it's usually for one of these reasons.

cards.title: Gap Between Leases
cards.text: Move-out on the 31st, move-in a week later. We hold everything in between.

cards.title: Home Sale Delays
cards.text: A closing that moves at the last minute doesn't leave your furniture on the sidewalk.

cards.title: Long-Term Storage
cards.text: A semester abroad, a deployment or a slow renovation. Store for as long as you need.

cards.title: Partial Storage
cards.text: Moving into a smaller place? Store the pieces that don't fit yet and move the rest.

cards.title: Storage With a Long Distance Move
cards.text: Pickup in Boston, storage, then delivery out of state on the date the new home is ready.

cards.title: Office Storage
cards.text: Furniture and files stored between an old office lease and a new one.

areas.intro: Most of our storage moves start in Boston, our home market. We also pick up from the nearby cities listed below.

process.h2: How Moving and Storage Works in Boston

steps.title: Tell Us the Dates
steps.text: Pickup date, a rough delivery date and both addresses, plus how much is going into storage.

steps.title: Get One Quote
steps.text: A manager prices the move and the storage together. Storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up.

steps.title: Pickup and Store
steps.text: The crew wraps and loads your things and takes them into storage.

steps.title: Deliver When Ready
steps.text: On the date you choose, we load from storage and deliver to the new home.

whyChoose.h2: Why Choose Better Life Moving for Moving and Storage in Boston?
whyChoose.intro: Splitting a move between a moving company and a separate storage company means two contracts, two schedules and twice the handling. With us it's one company and one quote from pickup to delivery.

cards.title: One Company, Pickup to Delivery
cards.text: Packing, storage and delivery all come from Better Life Moving. Nothing is handed to another company along the way.

cards.title: Priced by the Cubic Foot
cards.text: Storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up, so a few boxes don't pay for a whole unit.

cards.title: Wrapped Before Storage
cards.text: Furniture goes into storage wrapped in blankets and shrink wrap, the same way it would for a direct move.

cards.title: Our Own Crews and Trucks
cards.text: A licensed carrier, USDOT 3866930, MC 1414489, moves your things in and out of storage.

faqHeading: Moving and Storage FAQ for Boston Customers

faq.q: How is moving and storage priced in Boston?
faq.a: Storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up. The move itself is billed hourly for local moves and at a flat rate for long distance moves.

faq.q: Can I store just part of my belongings?
faq.a: Yes. Many customers store the pieces that don't fit the new home yet and move everything else directly into the new home.

faq.q: How long can I keep things in storage?
faq.a: Short or long term, depending on what you need. Give us a rough delivery date when you request a quote.

faq.q: Can storage be combined with a long distance move?
faq.a: Yes. We pick up in Boston, store your things and deliver out of state once the new home is ready.

faq.q: Do I need to pack differently for storage?
faq.a: Pack boxes full and tape them shut so they stack well. The crew wraps furniture before it goes into storage.

faq.q: Can you deliver from storage to a different city than the pickup?
faq.a: Yes. Delivery can go to any address we serve, including another state, which turns the delivery leg into a long distance move quoted at a flat rate. Tell us the destination when you request a quote so the manager prices both parts together.

faqClosing: Still have a question about storage? Our FAQ page covers billing, booking and moving day.
